name: Lotus Thai Cuisine
notes: Router said no-platform. Own site (lotusthaisd.com, a MyMenuBox-built site) has separate static, fully-priced pages under its main nav: /lunch-menu, /dinner, /drinks, /desert, each read directly (not the client-side React ordering widget at lotusthaisd.getbento.com, which is a JS shell with no exposed API found in the time budget and was not used for pricing). Many dinner/lunch dishes are priced by a protein ladder printed directly above the section (e.g. 'Choose From: Tofu $15.99 | Vegetables $16.99 | Chicken/Pork/Mock Meat $17.99 | Beef $18.99 | Shrimp/Squid $20.99 | Duck/Scallop or Mixed Seafood $21.99'), and each dish's own line repeats its base (cheapest, usually tofu) price as '$X.XX/+' — only that printed base price was recorded, treated as a 'from' price per the build-your-own rule, never the higher tiers, which were not individually confirmed per dish. The Dinner page's 'Noodles' section is an exception: its section-header ladder read Tofu $15.99, but every listed dish's own line printed $14.99/+ instead — the per-item printed price was trusted over the (apparently mismatched/stale) header ladder. One stray line on the Drinks page ('Lemon Grass Beef Satay... $9' inside the Cocktails list) is an evident copy-paste artifact from the Dinner Starters section and was dropped rather than filed as a second, conflicting price for the same dish already captured at $12.99. 'Thai Iced Coffee' was listed with no standalone price (ran together with the next item's price in the source markup) and was dropped rather than guessed. Catering page (party trays, 6-8/10-12 person quantities) excluded as an adjunct per the playbook. Wines/beer/sake/cocktails on the restaurant's own Drinks page are treated as a core Drinks menu (not a back-bar reference), consistent with 'happy hour' style dedicated menus counting as core. 137 dishes across Lunch Specials, Dinner (Starters, Chef's Specialties, Steamed Dim Sum, Salads, Soups, Stir Fried, Noodles, Noodle Soups, Curries, Fried Rice, Side Orders), Drinks (Cocktails, Red Wines, White Wines, Beer, Non-Alcoholic, Sake), and Dessert.
